title: Fit It at the Pit
lines: I am Tim. Sam is at a pit.
It is a mat. Fit it at the pit!
Tip it, Sam. Pat it, Tim.
The mat fit! Tim and Sam sit.
Sip, Tim. Sip, Sam. Sip, sip!

questions.listenFor: At a pit — the sand pit. Line one says it. Let them find the word pit rather than being told.

questions.ask: What do Tim and Sam do once the mat fits?
questions.listenFor: They sit down, and then they sip. The last two lines say it.

questions.ask: Where would you spread a mat to sit? Tell me why you picked that spot.
questions.listenFor: Any spot they can give a reason for. You are listening for the because, not the place.
